==Description==
{{Color|{{FULLPAGENAME}}|0}} is a gear set designed by a "mad" [[Tianshi]] of Hongshan Swordmancers. The design and innovation take inspirations from his food and kitchen observations.<ref>[[Eternal Xiranite Armor]]</ref> his innovation in this gear set include:
* self-feeding cycle which doubled the power duration of '''Eternal Xiranite''' protective equipment.<ref>[[Eternal Xiranite Auxiliary Arm]]</ref>
* next generation of [[Xiranite]]-based refrigeration technology for power core cooling.<ref>[[Eternal Xiranite Power Core]]</ref>
the mad Tianshi began to reject any food that "fail to deliver inspirations". he soon disappeared into the wildlands in pursuit of "palatable Xiranite".<ref>[[Eternal Xiranite Gloves]]</ref>
